boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten documented no-admission Omaha places for a low-key outing, walk, art stop, or shared study break.

cards.title: Browse the Joslyn galleries
cards.subtitle: 2200 Dodge St, Omaha
cards.notes: Meet at the museum entrance, choose a few galleries to explore together, then compare one artwork each before heading back.
cards.short_summary: A free museum outing built around permanent galleries and most temporary exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: Joslyn states that everyone is admitted at no cost during regular museum hours, including permanent galleries and most temporary exhibitions.
cards.access_notes: Free general admission applies during regular museum hours; the museum is closed Mondays and major holidays.

cards.title: See a student-art exhibition
cards.subtitle: Weber Fine Arts Building, UNO Dodge Campus
cards.notes: Check the exhibition listing, walk the first-floor gallery at your own pace, and use a favorite work as a conversation starter.
cards.short_summary: A public university gallery with rotating art exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: UNO identifies the gallery in Weber Fine Arts and says admission is free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Free and open to the public Monday–Friday, 10 a.m.–4 p.m.; closed weekends, holidays, and academic breaks.

cards.entity_name: Samuel Bak Museum: The Learning Center
cards.title: Spend an hour with Samuel Bak's art
cards.subtitle: University of Nebraska Omaha, Dodge Campus
cards.notes: Plan a quiet gallery visit with a classmate and pause at works that invite discussion about art, history, and human rights.
cards.short_summary: A public art and learning center on UNO's campus.
cards.evidence_claim: UNO states that the Samuel Bak Museum: The Learning Center is free to the public.
cards.source_title: Samuel Bak Museum: The Learning Center
cards.access_notes: The university describes the center as free to the public; confirm current gallery availability before traveling.

cards.entity_name: Lewis and Clark National Historic Trail Visitor Center
cards.title: Talk trail history with a ranger
cards.subtitle: 601 Riverfront Dr, Omaha
cards.notes: Explore the interpretive displays, pick up maps, and give yourselves time to ask a ranger about the trail's Omaha connections.
cards.short_summary: A free National Park Service visitor center beside the Missouri River.
cards.evidence_claim: The National Park Service says its Omaha visitor center is free of charge and offers historical and interpretive information.
cards.access_notes: Free of charge; listed hours are daily 8:30 a.m.–4:30 p.m., with holiday closures noted by NPS.

cards.title: Wander the lawn and sculpture garden
cards.subtitle: The RiverFront, downtown Omaha
cards.notes: Use the lawn as a meet-up point, walk through the sculpture garden, and linger by the preserved slides near 11th and Farnam.
cards.short_summary: The urban park portion of Omaha's connected RiverFront.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit Omaha says all 72 acres of The RiverFront are free; The RiverFront identifies Gene Leahy Mall as one of its three parks.
cards.source_title: Free and Cheap Family Fun in Omaha
cards.access_notes: No admission is required for the park; RiverFront park hours are listed as 5 a.m.–11 p.m. daily.

cards.title: Take a waterfront walk
cards.subtitle: The RiverFront, downtown Omaha
cards.notes: Start near the water, take an unhurried loop through the park, and bring a friend for a screen-free conversation between classes.
cards.short_summary: A waterfront section of Omaha's three-park RiverFront.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit Omaha says all 72 acres of The RiverFront are free, and The RiverFront identifies Heartland of America Park as a component park.
cards.source_title: Free and Cheap Family Fun in Omaha
cards.access_notes: No admission is required for the park; RiverFront park hours are listed as 5 a.m.–11 p.m. daily.

cards.title: Meet by the Missouri River
cards.subtitle: The RiverFront, downtown Omaha
cards.notes: Walk the landing's river edge with a friend, use the seating for a catch-up, and pair it with the nearby visitor center.
cards.short_summary: A Missouri River park space within The RiverFront.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit Omaha says all 72 acres of The RiverFront are free, and The RiverFront identifies Lewis and Clark Landing as a component park.
cards.source_title: Free and Cheap Family Fun in Omaha
cards.access_notes: No admission is required for the park; RiverFront park hours are listed as 5 a.m.–11 p.m. daily.

cards.title: Walk across the state line
cards.subtitle: Missouri River, downtown Omaha
cards.notes: Cross the bridge together, stop at the state-line marker for a photo, and return via the same route or nearby RiverFront paths.
cards.short_summary: A pedestrian bridge linking Nebraska and Iowa over the Missouri River.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit Omaha states that the Bob Kerrey Pedestrian Bridge is free and open year-round.
cards.source_title: Free and Cheap Family Fun in Omaha
cards.access_notes: Free and open year-round according to Visit Omaha; use the bridge as a pedestrian outing and follow posted conditions.

cards.title: Photograph the historic locomotives
cards.subtitle: 100 Bancroft St, Omaha
cards.notes: Walk the interpretive signs around Big Boy No. 4023 and Centennial No. 6900, then trade photos of the details you noticed.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor locomotive display with interpretive signage.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit Omaha lists Kenefick Park as free and describes its two displayed Union Pacific locomotives and interpretive signage.
cards.access_notes: Listed as free by Visit Omaha, with daily hours of 9 a.m.–5 p.m.

cards.title: Read and reset at the Downtown Branch
cards.subtitle: 1401 Jones St, Omaha
cards.notes: Choose the quiet reading room for a shared study session or independent reset, then browse the building's preserved historic details.
cards.short_summary: A downtown library branch with reading, study, and meeting spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Omaha Public Library says there is no cost to visit a library and describes the Downtown Branch's quiet reading room, study rooms, and community spaces.
cards.source_title: About | Omaha Public Library Downtown Branch
cards.access_notes: Library visits are free; access is subject to the branch's current public hours and posted library rules.
